PCI.BIO: Juan Bosquez is Professional Engineer who has been practicing for over 20 years.  His experience includes the design and construction of transportation projects throughout the State of Texas.

PASTHIST.ORG: The University of Texas at Rio Grande Valley
PASTHIST.TITLE: Lecturer III
PASTHIST.DESC: I am the instructor for the Senior Design course in civil engineering that provides a practical approach on project development.

PASTHIST.TITLE: Area Engineer
PASTHIST.DESC: As the San Benito Area Engineer, I managed the construction, planning, design, and maintenance operations for Cameron, Willacy, and Kennedy counties.

PASTHIST.ORG: The University of Texas at Rio Grande Valley
PASTHIST.TITLE: Lecturer III
PASTHIST.DESC: I was the instructor for the Materials in Construction course in civil engineering that provides basic material knowledge on testing and applications.

PASTHIST.TITLE: Construction Manager
PASTHIST.DESC: As Texas Construction Services Manager, I worked on developing Construction Services for Transportation as part of the company's expansion into Texas.

PASTHIST.TITLE: Project Manager
PASTHIST.DESC: As Project Manager, I managed the construction of transportation projects in Texas and provided Quality Control Management on design-build projects.

EDUCATION.SCHOOL: The University of Texas at Arlington
EDUCATION.DISSTITLE: A Comprehensive Study of Recycled Concrete Aggregates as a Drainable Base Layer for Pavements

LICCERT.TITLE: Licensed Professional Engineer
LICCERT.DESC: Licensed Professional Engineer in Civil Engineering for the State of Texas
